title: Guest's statistical analysis of Ganzfeld telepathy trials

tellings.quote:
the hit
rate across the best trials or at least
the best quality studies seems to be
around 30 to 35%.

plain: In Ganzfeld trials, a kind of telepathy test from the 1970s where a person in mild sensory isolation tries to sense which image someone elsewhere is looking at, the best-run studies score hits about 30 to 35 percent of the time. Maaneli Derakhshani, a guest who has looked at the statistics, tells Michels this, drawing on the work of the parapsychologist Charles Honorton. If the figure holds, the results would beat what guessing alone should give.
